meta.title: Profile Quiz
meta.description: Answer 14 quick questions (the last is an optional free-text) and we'll match you to master's programs in Europe.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.validation: Some answers were missing or unrecognized. Please try again.

mascot.default: There's no right or wrong answer — just what feels right for you!

loading.title: Matching you to programs…
loading.subtitle: Our AI is comparing your answers against every program in the catalog. This usually takes about 2 seconds.

stages.askingAi: Asking the AI matcher to rank your top 3

freeText.requiredHint: A sentence or two is plenty — it sharpens your matches.
freeText.optionalHint: You can skip this — the AI will still match using your other answers.

destinations.legend: Which destination feels right for your master's journey?
destinations.helper: Pick one or more. Choose "No preference" if you're open to anywhere.
destinations.matchingAllCountries: Matching across all 18 countries in our catalog.
destinations.clickToAdd: Click any highlighted country to add it. Click a chip to remove.
destinations.selectedCount: {count} selected — click again to remove, or pick more.
destinations.globeAriaLabel: Globe — drag to rotate, click a highlighted country to select
destinations.countSelectedAria: {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}} selected.

current_situation.legend: What best describes your current situation?

optionDescriptions.recent_graduate: Finished within the last couple of years
optionDescriptions.gap_year: Graduated and currently taking time before the next step

other.placeholder: Tell us in a few words…

legend.undergraduate: Which university are you studying at?
legend.graduatingSoon: Which university will you graduate from?
legend.graduated: Which university did you graduate from?
legend.default: Which university did you study at?

institution.helper: Start typing to search Turkish universities — or type any institution if yours isn't listed.
institution.notListedHint: Not listed? Just type it in — we'll use exactly what you write.

study_background.helper: Your undergraduate field, in your own words — just what you studied. The AI reads this to judge fit and eligibility. (What you want to study next is the following question.)
study_background.placeholder: e.g. BSc Civil Engineering, or BA Sociology with an econ minor…

desired_study.legend: What do you want to study?
desired_study.helper: Be as free as you like. A field works ("economics"), so does something very specific ("political economy of East Asia") — and even a vague "I like politics" is enough. We'll work out the right programs either way.
desired_study.placeholder: e.g. data science, sustainable architecture, or just 'something with politics'…

gpa_range.helper: Pick the grading scale your school uses, then type your exact GPA. Not every school grades the same way — a ballpark is fine.
gpa_range.chooseScalePrompt: First, which grading scale does your school use?

english_level.legend: How would you describe your English?
english_level.helper: We'll match against each program's actual entry requirement. Self-assessment is fine.

options.certified: I have a valid IELTS / TOEFL / Duolingo score

optionDescriptions.certified: Test already passed and in date
optionDescriptions.exam_ready: Could pass the test, just haven't booked it yet

budget_per_year.helper: Tuition only — not living costs. We'll show scholarships separately.

optionDescriptions.tuition_free: Public universities with no or nominal tuition, or full scholarships

duration_preference.legend: How long do you want your program to be?

options.required: Required — I need funding to attend
options.helpful: Helpful — I'd take one but can manage without

career_goal.legend: What's your goal after the master's?
career_goal.helper: We use this to weigh program character, location, and brand differently.

options.return_to_turkey: Return to Turkey with an international degree
options.phd_research: Pursue a PhD or research career
options.industry_expert: Grow into a senior / specialist role in my field
options.career_switch: Switch into a new field or industry

other.placeholder: Describe your goal in a few words…

academic_focus.legend: What style of master's appeals to you?
academic_focus.helper: We'll weigh research-heavy programs differently from job-oriented ones.

optionDescriptions.research: Stepping stone to a PhD, theoretical depth, thesis-driven
optionDescriptions.balanced: A bit of both — keep options open

work_experience.legend: How much full-time work experience do you have?
work_experience.helper: Some programs (like LBS MiM) prefer 1-3 years; others welcome fresh graduates.

additional_context.helper: Specific labs you want to work with, family in a city you'd join, why this field really, anything we'd miss from multiple choice. The AI reads this and quotes it in your rationale.
additional_context.placeholder: e.g. I want to be near my partner in Berlin, or I'm aiming for Prof. Smith's robotics lab at TU Delft…
